Done! I've added invoice numbering with two new components:

**`src/numbering.js`** with `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)`
- Generates numbers in format `INV-<year>-<counter>` (e.g., `INV-2024-0001`)
- Counter is 4 digits, zero-padded, starts at 0001
- Restarts each year (2024 and 2025 both start at 0001)
- Handles numbers in any order and ignores malformed entries

**`issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`** added to `src/invoices.js`
- Assigns a number via `nextInvoiceNumber` and marks invoice as 'issued'
- Returns `NOT_DRAFT` if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- Never mutates the original invoice

Added comprehensive tests covering all cases including year boundaries, unordered numbers, malformed entries, and mutation prevention. All 50 tests pass ✔
